Definition: from G1537 and G797; to lighten forth, i.e. (figuratively) to be radiant (of very white garments):--glistening.
BiblicalUsage: exastráptō is the word for glistening. In Luke 9:29, the text says "and his raiment [was] white [and] glistering."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, exastráptō means glistening, and I leave it at that.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
